'''Talan-De''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. He aided the [[Voss commandos]] stationed at the [[Shad-Ka Outpost]] and also aided the visitors to the [[Nightmare Lands]] in performing the guarding rituals created by the [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] [[Ki-Da]] that were necessary to protect one from the region's corrupting influences.
